display.purpose: Roboto Mono at weight 200; phone overrides are documented in DESIGN.md.

title.purpose: Light Archivo heading for setup, settings, memory and journal.

label.purpose: Actual label elements associated with their controls.

field.purpose: Mono input and select text; phone size is 16px.

navigation.purpose: Tracked uppercase labels for the four destinations.

action.purpose: Tracked uppercase action name; supporting sentence retains normal case.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared settling curve for the optical plate and conversation entrance.

motion.name: optical-state
motion.purpose: One optical plate shifts between home, reading and conversation.

motion.name: conversation-entrance
motion.purpose: On mount: translateY(12px), blur(3px), opacity .65 settle to zero offset, no blur and opacity 1.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Primary and secondary form button state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important
motion.purpose: Applied to every element and pseudo-element under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

notes: Tonal ramps are synthesized preview-only OKLCH values, preserving each source hue and chroma while stepping lightness. Alpha colors use their RGB channels for the preview. They are not application tokens.
Sources: app/web/App.tsx, Icon.tsx, Forms.tsx, styles.css, motion.css and forms.css. Styles load in that order: styles, motion, forms. Documentation does not claim a final visual-review pass.

One shipping raster: app/web/public/art/prism-soft.png (1024 x 1536). The final edit softened the existing arc perimeter. Exact prompt: .impeccable/prism-soft-prompt.txt; prompt metadata is embedded in the PNG.

Optical plate: fixed behind the shell, pointer-events none, object-fit cover, object-position center top, mix-blend-mode lighten. Desktop size is min(90vw, 1320px) by 130vh, top 0, right -6vw. Phone size is 100vw by calc(100vw * 1.5), top 52px, right 0.

Scene cascade: desktop home opacity .86; phone home .82. Reading uses opacity .17 and translateY(30vh). Desktop conversation uses .34 and translateY(46vh); desktop generation changes opacity to .48. Phone conversation uses .38 and translateY(48vh); its later equal-specificity rule also holds .38 during generation.
No box shadows or backdrop blur. The optical plate must blend into carbon without an image-shaped boundary.
Shell: max-width 1600px and 6vw inline padding; phone padding 20px. Home width min(560px, 52%), conversation max-width 800px, documents max-width 760px.

Desktop active conversation height calc(100dvh - 132px), min-height 350px, bottom padding 26px. Phone height calc(100dvh - 74px), min-height 340px, bottom padding max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)). Messages scroll independently above the composer.

Phone navigation: fixed bottom bar, min-height 70px, padding 8px 28px max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), background #090a09f5. Hidden during active conversation. Document bottom clearance is 100px on phones and 80px on desktop.
Focus outline: 2px solid var(--ink), offset 5px. Composer textarea suppresses its outline and uses its container focus-within border. Buttons disabled: opacity .45, cursor not-allowed.

Icons are Phosphor thin. The ArrowRight and ArrowUp snippet paths were copied from the installed package. Snippets are static, framework-free previews; their layout anchoring and real behavior belong to the application.
Fonts are local: archivo.ttf and roboto-mono.ttf, with OFL.txt and RobotoMono-OFL.txt. Saira is not loaded. No chip component is implemented in the current interface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bone form action for saving settings or continuing setup.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;min-height:46px;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;font:13px/1.5 var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s;background:var(--ink, #e9e8e2);color:var(--carbon, #090a09);border:1px solid var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-primary:hover{background:#ffffff;border-color:#ffffff}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink, #e9e8e2);outline-offset:5px}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet bordered action for testing a connection or retrying a reply.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;min-height:46px;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;font:13px/1.5 var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s;background:var(--surface, #141513);color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2);border:1px solid var(--rule, #353632)}.ds-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0);background:var(--surface, #141513)}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink, #e9e8e2);outline-offset:5px}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}

components.name: Send Button
components.description: Thin Phosphor arrow with a left separator; the app swaps it for Stop during generation.

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: A real label, neutral input and connected helper.
components.html: Use the exact model name from Ollama.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin:24px 0;color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0);font:14px/1.5 var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace)}.ds-field input{width:100%;background:var(--surface, #141513);border:1px solid var(--rule, #353632);border-radius:8px;color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0);padding:13px 15px;font:14px/1.6 var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace);caret-color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-field input:focus{border-color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0);opacity:1}.ds-field small{font:12px/1.8 var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace);color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink, #e9e8e2);outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-field input{font-size:16px}}

components.name: Main Navigation
components.description: Four mono destinations with a current-page dot; viewport anchoring belongs to the app shell.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Main"><button type="button" aria-current="page">Home</button><button type="button">Memory</button><button type="button">Journal</button><button type="button">Settings</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px}.ds-nav button{position:relative;min-height:44px;font:11px/1.5 var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0);padding:12px 8px;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button:hover,.ds-nav button[aria-current]{color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-nav button[aria-current]::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:0;left:calc(50% - 2px);width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink, #e9e8e2);outline-offset:5px}.ds-nav button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-nav{justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.ds-nav button{font-size:10px;min-width:48px;letter-spacing:.09em;padding:9px 0 17px}.ds-nav button[aria-current]::after{bottom:5px}}

components.name: Home Action Row
components.description: Open action row that prepares an editable conversation starter.
components.css: .ds-action{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;min-height:67px;padding:15px 6px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule, #353632);text-align:left;font:11px/1.6 var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace);letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;background:none;color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2);cursor:pointer}.ds-action:hover{background:#e9e8e208}.ds-action small{display:block;color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0);font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.025em;text-transform:none;margin-top:2px}.ds-action svg{color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0);flex-shrink:0;margin-left:16px}.ds-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink, #e9e8e2);outline-offset:5px}.ds-action:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(min-width:761px) and (max-height:850px){.ds-action{min-height:58px;padding-block:10px}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-action{min-height:55px;padding:11px 6px;font-size:10px}.ds-action small{font-size:11px}}

components.name: Conversation Composer
components.description: Pill-shaped Archivo textarea and thin send action; the sample does not send messages.
components.css: .ds-composer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:10px 12px 10px 24px;border:1px solid #53544e;border-radius:25px;background:#151613b8;min-height:58px;flex-shrink:0;color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0)}.ds-composer textarea{display:block;width:100%;min-width:0;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2);outline:none;resize:none;font:300 16px/1.6 Archivo,sans-serif;padding:3px 0;max-height:150px;caret-color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-composer textarea::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0);opacity:1}.ds-composer-send{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:40px;flex-shrink:0;border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--rule, #353632);background:none;color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2);cursor:pointer}.ds-composer-send:hover:enabled{color:#fff;background:#e9e8e210;border-radius:0 14px 14px 0}.ds-composer-send:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink, #e9e8e2);outline-offset:5px}.ds-composer-send:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-composer-send{width:39px;height:38px}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-composer{min-height:53px;padding:7px 9px 7px 20px;border-radius:24px;gap:8px}}

components.name: Preview Reply
components.description: Static setup preview panel; sample text is illustrative.
components.css: .ds-preview{margin:30px 0;padding:28px;background:var(--surface, #141513);border-radius:12px;color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-preview>span{font:12px var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace);color:var(--ink, #e9e8e2)}.ds-preview>p{font:18px/1.8 Archivo,sans-serif;white-space:pre-wrap;margin:15px 0}.ds-preview small{font:11px/1.7 var(--mono, "Roboto Mono", monospace);color:var(--muted, #a5a6a0)}

components.name: Companion Message
components.description: Outlined Archivo reply with quiet mono metadata; sample text is illustrative.

narrative.overview:
Prism is the owner's approved retro-futurist editorial minimalism: carbon, bone and graphite, generous space, fine rules, and one grainy optical arc. The arc carries presence while the controls remain quiet. This replaces the previous stone-and-coral world.

The reference governs atmosphere and visual language. The owner approved working-app adaptations: real setup, conversation, memory, journal and settings retain their function. The companion name is configurable; the greeting follows local time.
keyCharacteristics: One optical plate dissolving into a carbon field.
Roboto Mono at weight 200 for the greeting; Archivo for conversation and body text.
Small tracked mono controls, open action rows, and fine neutral borders.
A pill composer, outlined message bubbles, and restrained document forms.
State-based optical movement and one conversation entrance, with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Singular Arc Rule
rules.body: Keep spectral color in the optical artwork; use neutral controls and the existing warm error treatment.

rules.name: The Thin Greeting Rule
rules.body: Use Roboto Mono at weight 200 for the greeting, Archivo for reading, and compact mono labels for controls.

rules.name: The Unframed Light Rule
rules.body: The optical plate must dissolve into the page without an image-shaped box, border, or card.

dos: Do carry the carbon, bone and graphite world through home, conversation and documents.
Do use the actual Roboto Mono greeting and Archivo reading roles.
Do keep the optical plate singular, grainy and unframed.
Do preserve keyboard focus, real labels, working controls and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep the companion name configurable and model-location copy tied to real configuration.
Do preserve shipping artwork provenance and local font licenses.
donts: Don't restore the retired stone, coral controls or desktop side rails.
Don't turn the spectral arc into repeated gradients, cards or decorative widgets.
Don't substitute Saira for the shipped Roboto Mono display face.
Don't add voice, music or attachment controls that the application does not implement.
Don't present demo copy as actual memory, conversation or capability status.
